checks.observed: NOT_APPLICABLE. CC-X04 adds conformance data, one measurement runner, tests, and verification evidence only.

limitations: CC-X04 is measurement only. It does not select desired future behavior, close OD-004, create a decision matrix, or authorize a migration, bridge, epoch, or new reader.
One physical copy is retained because independently executed v0.11.0 and v0.13.3 writer paths produced identical bytes. No historical Python environment or dependency set was reconstructed.
Recon acceptance uses the existing receipt mechanism. CC-X04 creates no migration and makes no claim that receipt-based acceptance is the future policy.
The knowledge-graph and protocol refusals are raw current-reader results, not selected compatibility outcomes.
The two protocol artifacts pass only intrinsic validation. Their end-to-end replay was not reached because the enclosing protocol ledger failed at event 1.

Candidate staging applies current structural and temporal validation while fixing graph identity to the frozen snapshot ontology hash. It does not claim that the current ontology registry accepts that historical hash as one of its own identities.

Observations are bound to reader commit 7178bd06e83cb5850afea5af6747e53c03730eec, tree e218f60b6cf2abbe11372965b7feed31b0677183, eight Python-source digests, and two ontology-source digests. A bound source change requires a fresh measurement.
CC-X04 changes no production, ontology, dependency, Docker, release, or packaging surface and makes no claim about those surfaces.
